title: DEFINE stage gates D1..D8 pure check functions
description: Pure module. One check function per stage D1..D8 (checkD1Brief..checkD8Freeze) plus STAGE_ORDER, STAGE_GATES, STAGE_SHORT_NAMES, INTERFACE_KINDS. Each takes (tree, context) and returns { stage, gate, state, checks[] } in the section 2.4 shape.
